properties.note: H-bonded three-component pre-reaction complex (formaldehyde O2...H6-O5 formic acid, methyl isocyanide C9 3.9 A from C1). Clean minimum, 0 imaginary frequencies. B3LYP-D3BJ/def2SVP, SMD dichloromethane.
C1-C9 bond formation with lagging O5-H6 -> O2 proton transfer (C1-C9 1.871 A, C1-O2 1.268, O2-H6 1.474, O5-H6 1.041). One imaginary frequency.
Nitrilium cation CH3-N+~C-CH2-OH ion-paired with formate; O2-H...O5 H-bond. Clean minimum, 0 imaginary frequencies. IRC from TS1 ends here (jobs/irc1.log).

Barrierless nucleophilic addition of the formate O5 to the nitrilium carbon C9: the relaxed scan jobs/scan3.log (O5-C9 2.98 -> 1.45 A) is monotonically downhill (40 kcal/mol, no maximum), so no first-order saddle exists; this node carries the ion-pair geometry/energy at the top of that path.
O-formyl alpha-hydroxy imidate CH3-N=C(O-CHO)(CH2OH). Clean minimum, 0 imaginary frequencies.

Upper bound for the concerted O2/O5 swap (formyloxy migration onto C1 plus O2-H6 -> N8): geometry and energy are the relaxed constrained point at O2-C9 = 1.84 A in jobs/scan5.log. No first-order saddle was located for this step at this level of theory (see PROCESS.md), so this barrier is an upper bound rather than a verified saddle.
